claims.text: The resort is set across two naturally formed islands in the South Ari Atoll.

findings.quote: Set across two naturally formed islands in the South Ari Atoll, Conrad Maldives Rangali Island offers a secluded sanctuary suspended between sky and sea.
findings.note: States the two naturally formed islands in South Ari Atoll.

claims.text: The Muraka has a master bedroom submerged beneath the sea.

findings.quote: Creator of The Muraka, the world’s first two-level residence with a master bedroom submerged beneath the sea; an engineering and design marvel.
findings.note: Says the master bedroom is submerged beneath the sea.

claims.text: The Deluxe Water Villa with Pool has a private infinity pool, a lagoon-view deck and direct ocean access.

findings.quote: Your private infinity pool, lagoon-view deck, and direct ocean access set the tone for an effortless overwater escape.
findings.note: Description listed under Deluxe Water Villa with Pool.

claims.text: The Deluxe Beach Villa with Pool has a private plunge pool and an open-air shower.

findings.quote: This elegant beachfront villa offers a private plunge pool, a tranquil open air shower, and seamless indoor outdoor living.
findings.note: Description listed under Deluxe Beach Villa with Pool.

claims.text: The Family Beach Villa is two interconnected villas with direct beach access, built for families.

findings.quote: Two interconnected villas with direct access to the beach, this unique experience is built for families who want both comfort, space and connection.
findings.note: Description listed under Family Beach Villa.

claims.text: The 2 Bedroom Rangali Ocean Pavilion with Pool has private sandbank access.

findings.quote: Private sandbank access
findings.note: Listed as a feature and amenity of the pavilion.

claims.text: The 3 Bedroom Beach Suite with Pool has two master bedrooms and a stand-alone twin bedroom villa within its compound.

findings.quote: Designed for privacy and comfort complete with 2 Master bedrooms and 1 stand-alone twin bed villa within the compound
findings.note: Confirms two master bedrooms and a stand-alone twin villa within the compound.

claims.text: The Wine Cellar is two meters underground, a first for the Maldives.

findings.quote: Descend two meters underground, a first for the Maldives, where 18,000 bottles and up to 800 labels slumber in perfect stillness.
findings.note: Confirms two meters underground and a first for the Maldives.

claims.text: Guests can join the resort's marine biologists to adopt a coral in a coral restoration experience.

findings.quote: Join our team of marine biologists at Ocean Conservation for an immersive coral restoration experience.
findings.note: Listed under the Adopt a Coral experience.

findings.quote: The journey continues with a hands-on workshop where you’ll attach your adopted coral to a line.
findings.note: Confirms guests adopt a coral.

claims.text: A snorkeling experience offers encounters with nurse sharks in shallow waters.

findings.quote: Enjoy a calm and fascinating snorkeling encounter with nurse sharks in shallow waters.
findings.note: Describes the Swimming with Nurse Sharks experience.

claims.text: A lagoon tour by boat weaves between the resort's two islands.

findings.quote: Embark on a breathtaking boat journey that weaves between our two distinct islands exploring the vibrant oceanic wonders that surround the resort.
findings.note: Description listed under Lagoon Tour.

claims.text: The resort's sustainability work includes coral regeneration, solar power and community-led farming.

findings.quote: From coral regeneration to solar-powered innovation and community-led farming, we’re committed to preserving our natural world while enriching the lives it touches.
findings.note: Covers all three named elements.

claims.text: The Muraka, described as the world's first undersea residence, is a two-level residence whose underwater suite has a 180-degree acrylic dome.

findings.quote: The world’s first undersea residence, The Muraka is an extraordinary two-level sanctum where an underwater suite with a 180-degree acrylic dome immerses you in life beneath the ocean’s surface.
findings.note: Covers the description, the two levels and the 180-degree dome.

claims.text: The resort is home to Ithaa, described as the world's first underwater restaurant, five meters below the Indian Ocean's surface.

findings.quote: Home to Ithaa, the world’s first underwater restaurant, offering a one-of-a-kind dining experience five Meters below the Indian Ocean’s surface.
findings.note: Covers the description and the depth.

claims.text: Whale sharks and manta rays can be encountered year-round in the surrounding waters.

findings.quote: while whale sharks and manta rays can be encountered year-round in the surrounding waters.
findings.note: Directly stated.

claims.text: The resort has two distinct spas offering indigenous Maldivian rituals.

findings.quote: Surrender to the rhythmic lull of the ocean at our two distinct spas. Curate your path to renewal with indigenous Maldivian rituals.
findings.note: Two distinct spas with indigenous Maldivian rituals.

claims.text: The resort has a PADI Eco Center focused on reef education and active coral restoration.

findings.quote: Embrace our commitment to the ocean at one of the Maldives’ rare PADI Eco Centers. Safeguard thriving reefs through immersive education and active coral restoration for a truly meaningful voyage.
findings.note: Covers the PADI Eco Center, education and coral restoration.

claims.text: The manta snorkeling trip goes to a site about an hour away from the resort.

findings.quote: Join us for an adventure just an hour away from the resort to experience the Maldives’ abundant marine life.
findings.note: Description listed under Manta Talk & Snorkeling.

claims.text: In the 2 Bedroom Grand Water Villa, parents with children under 12 are asked to sign a disclaimer on arrival.

findings.quote: Parents with children under 12 will be asked to sign a disclaimer upon arrival.
findings.note: Stated on the 2 Bedroom Grand Water Villa page.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the remote location requires a seaplane transfer.
